description:
Which US metros to search for new sources, in order, and the sources XP already has.

Metros are US cities ranked by upcoming XP events. `near` comes first, then metros with no
sources yet, then the rest. Each metro lists its `known_sources`; `national_sources` have no
metro. Skip anything already known. Set geo_metro to the metro label exactly as given here
when you call add_my_sources or submit_discovered_sources.

agent_name.description: This agent's name, unique among your agents, e.g. 'grok-chicago-1'. Each name is tracked separately.

near.description: The person's city if you know it, e.g. 'Ann Arbor, MI' or 'Chicago'. It goes first.
